session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Broad Bull Channel From The Open'. Major bull surprise drove an opening broad bull channel (green giant wedge 4340-4375); wedge bull flag higher low major trend reversal at 08:20 low 4348, nested wedge bear flag stall at 09:15 high 4377, then the usual couple hours of trading range inside the channel before a 12:30 breakout test bear trap wedge bull flag trend resumption up into the close near 4380.
